title: Rule-version compatibility text and mismatch fallback vector permit downgrade ambiguity
description: spec/03 says Version 3 is the only operational registry and mismatch forbids DODAG admission/Rule255 inside it, yet also says old rules remain supported one release; the draft implies roots alone advertise while parent-selectable non-roots must propagate; rule_versioning.json marks mismatch fallback true without the mandatory outside-DODAG context. Make operational/legacy support scopes explicit, require every parent-selectable DIO to propagate authenticated version, and encode inside/outside DODAG fallback cases.
